name: Admin Diagnostic Defaults Config
description: Admin manages the per-language default config applied to new WebAppDiagnostic rows from /panel/diagnostics/defaults/. The General tab edits language, currency, default investment amount, default duration label, payment percentages (auto-synced to sum 100, default 60/40), and reminder/urgency/expiration days. Save PUTs /api/diagnostics/defaults/?lang= and the response is applied directly (no refetch). Reset opens a ConfirmModal and POSTs /defaults/reset/ to delete the row, falling back to the hardcoded seed. Sections, Plantillas de Email (link), Prompt (placeholder) and JSON tabs render from the same config payload.
